name: Long Cutt Play Area
description: Play area reached by an alleyway from the Snatchup end of Long Cutt or from Hill Top, with a climbing frame and slide for over-3s, a multi-play structure for over-6s, a springer, a rotating seesaw, a rocking horse, and basket and regular swings. Basketball net and goal posts nearby.
notConfirmed: Exact position (taken from OpenStreetMap), toilets and parking.
